title: azalea speciosa var. aurantia
intro: Azalea speciosa var. aurantia, commonly known as the Golden Azalea, is a deciduous flowering shrub native to East Asia, characterized by its vibrant golden-yellow flowers and glossy green leaves. The Golden Azalea has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with its health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include calming the nervous system, reducing stress and anxiety, and improving sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Azalea speciosa var. aurantia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic effects.
